decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions, it is not considered that the proposed extension, due to its compatible size, position and appearance would harm neighbours' living conditions, the appearance of the street scene or highway safety. The proposal would also retain separate access to the residential flat above. The proposal therefore accords with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), S.4.7 (Access to upper floors) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - The extension hereby permitted shall only be used for the an extension of the shop floor and a storage of goods and servicing ancillary to the retail use of the premises known as 7 Green Parade, Whitton Road
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to shop.
